bg-*-gradient: Removed in v6 — a CoreUI-only addition. Use the base colour plus Bootstrap's generic gradient: class="bg-primary bg-gradient".
text-bg-*-gradient: Removed in v6 — a CoreUI-only addition. Use class="text-bg-primary bg-gradient".
elevation-*: Removed in v6 with the elevation system, which was disabled by default ($enable-elevations: false). Use the shadow utilities: .shadow, .shadow-sm, .shadow-lg.
calendar-nav-icon-*: Removed in v6 — the calendar navigation icons render in JavaScript now. Customize them with the navIconPrev / navIconNext / navIconDoublePrev / navIconDoubleNext options.
text-high-emphasis: Removed in v6 — a CoreUI-only addition, deprecated since v5.0.0. Use .text-body.
text-medium-emphasis: Removed in v6 — a CoreUI-only addition, deprecated since v5.0.0. Use .text-body-secondary.
text-high-emphasis-inverse: Removed in v6 — a CoreUI-only addition, deprecated since v5.0.0. Use .text-white with an opacity utility.
text-medium-emphasis-inverse: Removed in v6 — a CoreUI-only addition, deprecated since v5.0.0. Use .text-white with an opacity utility.
text-disabled-inverse: Removed in v6 — a CoreUI-only addition, deprecated since v5.0.0. Use .text-white with an opacity utility.
dark\\:text-*emphasis*: Removed in v6 with the emphasis utilities they varied — see .text-high-emphasis and friends above.
dark\\:text-disabled-inverse: Removed in v6 with the emphasis utilities — see .text-disabled-inverse above.
